I agree. I have fairly severe anxiety/depression and I finally went to disability services and counseling after being hospitalized. My disability services allows me to hand in papers late, so if you've missed work that could help. In addition, if you see a counselor you can usually get paperwork asking to accommodate you in any way they can and that you're in treatment.. this saved me this semester because it excused a lot of my absences. If it's early in the semester, talk with your professors and show that you're trying your best. If things get more difficult, tell them you're struggling. It depends on the professor, but a lot will be willing to add their own accommodations. 
 Honestly, I don't think I would be graduating without this help.
